description:
Senevita ist die grösste integrierte Anbieterin von Dienstleistungen im Alter und beschäftigt rund 4'000 Mitarbeitende. Ambulante und stationäre Angebote gehen nahtlos ineinander über. Während die Senevita Standorte für selbstständiges betreutes Wohnen und umfassende Pflege stehen, ist Senevita Casa die schweizweit führende Anbieterin privater Spitex-Leistungen.

Für die Senevita Wydenpark in Studen BE suchen wir per 1. August 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung genau DICH  als  Assistent/-in Gesundheit & Soziales
Pflegehelfer/-in
 50 - 100%
 Welcher Beschäftigungsgrad passt zu dir?
 Deine Mission

• Unser Motto lautet: "Hohe Lebensqualität für unsere Bewohnenden."
Hilfst du mit, dieses Ziel gemeinsam zu realisieren?

• Du vollbringst die tägliche Grundpflege, bringst deine kreativen Ideen in die Alltagsgestaltung ein und widmest dich hauswirtschaftlichen Tätigkeiten

• In deinem Beruf, nah am Menschen, kannst du viel Positives bewirken. Dies tust du mit Berufsstolz, Teamgeist und Herzlichkeit
 Dein Rüstzeug

• Abschluss als Pflegehelfer/in SRK, Pflegeassistent/in oder Assistent/in Gesundheit & Soziales EBA

• Freude an deinem Beruf und ein natürliches Interesse für Menschen

• Den Ansporn, zum Wohle unserer Bewohnenden, einen guten Job zu machen

• Neugierde auf dein neues Arbeitsumfeld, dein Team und deine sinnvolle Tätigkeit
 Darauf kannst du dich freuen

• Arbeitszeiten mit Flexibilität für Beruf und Familie

• Attraktives Weiterbildungsangebot der Senevita Akademie, welches zur laufenden Weiterentwicklung inspiriert

• Ein Umfeld, wo Berufsbildung GROSS geschrieben wird und für frischen Wind sorgt

• Gratis Zwischenverpflegung (Brot, Früchte, Mineralwasser, Heissgetränke) sowie ermässigtes Mittagessen - herzhaft zubereitet von unserem Gastro-Team

• Gratis SBB-Halbtax, Vergünstigungen (Tanken, Zusatzversicherungen, Fitness, Apotheke usw.)

• Gute Sozialleistungen und mind. 5 Wochen Ferien (ab 50 Jahren 6 Wochen, ab 60 Jahren 7 Wochen)

• Spannende Aktivitäten/Anlässe, die Mitarbeitende und Bewohnende bewegen

• Sehr gute Erreichbarkeit (unmittelbarer Autobahnanschluss, Lage direkt am Bahnhof Studen)

• Unser Commitment: Du als Mensch bist uns wichtig!

Gespannt? Wir auch!
Auf deine Bewerbung freuen wir uns und für weitere Auskünfte sind wir gerne für dich da.

Senevita è il più grande fornitore integrato di servizi in età avanzata e impiega circa 4.000 persone. Le offerte ambulatoriale e stazionario si fondono senza soluzione di continuità. Mentre le sedi di Senevita sono per la vita assistita indipendente e la cura completa, Senevita Casa è il fornitore leader di servizi privati Spitex in tutta la Svizzera. Per il Senevita Wydenpark a Studen BE stiamo cercando 1. Agosto 2026 o su appuntamento esattamente TU come assistente in salute & affari sociali Assistente/in infermieristica 50 - 100% Che livello di occupazione ti si addice? La tua missione
• Il nostro motto è "Alta qualità della vita per i nostri residenti". Stai aiutando a raggiungere questo obiettivo insieme?
• Si esegue la cura di base quotidiana, portare le vostre idee creative nella vita quotidiana e dedicarsi alle attività domestiche
• Nella tua professione, vicino alle persone, puoi fare un sacco di cose positive. Lo fai con orgoglio professionale, spirito di squadra e calore La vostra attrezzatura
• Laurea come assistente infermieristica, assistente infermieristica o assistente sociale EBA
• Gioia nella vostra professione e un interesse naturale per le persone
• L'incentivo, a beneficio dei nostri residenti, a fare un buon lavoro
• Curiosità circa il vostro nuovo ambiente di lavoro, il vostro team e il vostro lavoro significativo Non vedo l'ora.
• Ore lavorative con flessibilità per lavoro e famiglia
• Attraente ulteriore formazione offerta dall'Accademia Senevita, che ispira lo sviluppo continuo
• Un ambiente in cui la formazione professionale è scritta GROSS e fornisce un respiro di aria fresca
• Pasti intermedi gratuiti (pane, frutta, acqua minerale, bevande calde) e pranzo scontato - preparati con cura dal nostro team gastro
• Gratis FFS semiassi, sconti (fuelling, assicurazione complementare, fitness, farmacia, ecc)
• Buoni benefici sociali e almeno. 5 settimane di vacanza (da 50 anni 6 settimane, da 60 anni 7 settimane)
• Attività emozionanti / eventi che muovono dipendenti e residenti
• Ottima accessibilità (collegamento autostradale diretto, posizione direttamente alla stazione di Studen)

descriptionByLocale.en:
Senevita is the largest integrated provider of services in old age and employs around 4,000 people. Outpatient and stationary offerings merge seamlessly. While the Senevita locations stand for independent assisted living and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is the leading provider of private Spitex services throughout Switzerland. For the Senevita Wydenpark in Studen BE we are looking for 1. August 2026 or by appointment exactly YOU as an assistant in health & social affairs Nursing assistant/in 50 - 100% What level of employment suits you? Your mission
• Our motto is "High quality of life for our residents." Are you helping to achieve this goal together?
• You perform the day-to-day basic care, bring your creative ideas into everyday life and devote yourself to domestic activities
• In your profession, close to people, you can do a lot of positive things. You do this with professional pride, team spirit and warmth Your equipment
• Degree as a nursing assistant, nursing assistant or health & social assistant EBA
• Joy in your profession and a natural interest for people
• The incentive, for the benefit of our residents, to do a good job
• Curiosity about your new working environment, your team and your meaningful work You can look forward to that.
• Working hours with flexibility for work and family
• Attractive further education offered by the Senevita Academy, which inspires ongoing development
• An environment where vocational training is written GROSS and provides a breath of fresh air
• Free intermediate meals (bread, fruit, mineral water, hot drinks) as well as discounted lunch - heartily prepared by our gastro team
• Free SBB half-ax, discounts (fuelling, supplementary insurance, fitness, pharmacy, etc.)
• Good social benefits and at least. 5 weeks holiday (from 50 years 6 weeks, from 60 years 7 weeks)
• Exciting activities / events that move employees and residents
• Very good accessibility (direct motorway connection, location directly at Studen station)
• Our commitment: You as a person are important to us! Your next step Curious? We too! We look forward to your application and we are happy to provide you with further information. Tasks
• Our motto is "High quality of life for our residents." Are you helping to achieve this goal together?
• In your profession, close to people, you can do a lot of positive things. You do this with professional pride, team spirit and warmth Requirements
• Degree as a nursing assistant, nursing assistant or health & social assistant EBA
• Curiosity about your new working environment, your team and your meaningful work We offer
• Working hours with flexibility for work and family
• Our commitment: You as a person are important to us!
